answer_1.quote: we define four generation tasks of varying complexity to benchmark the ability of LVLMs to comprehend scientific plots: (1) captioning a single academic figure, (2) generating overall summaries for multiple sub-figures, (3) in-context figure captioning given previous figure-caption pairs, and (4) generating paper titles from figure-caption pairs.
answer_1.outputs: captions for figures, summaries for multiple sub-figures, paper titles

answer_2.quote: Metrics BLEU-2, ROUGE-L and BERT-Score are adopted as the automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: We also explore using GPT-4 to assist in caption evaluation.
methods: Prompting with a template to assign quality scores

answer_4.quote: We conduct a manual inspection for single-figure captioning results.
answer_4.guideline: Categorize generated captions into quality types: (1) Acceptable, (2) Over Simplification, (3) Recognition Error, (4) Contextual Misinterpretation.
